Author: kittenhaswares-ui
Name: Seiton Sense
Punchline: Persistent Seiton decisions, PvP warnings, and an optional one-key Purify helper.
Description: A local Crystalline Conflict reaction-cue HUD with an optional Wolves' Den duel test mode. Ninja gets persistent PREP and SHIFT+slot Seiton decisions; every job can see selected PvP warnings. The one-key/one-attempt Purify helper has separate toggles for every removable CC type and is disabled by default.
